description: The build TrackDIFF shows for a champion in its main role: starting items (+ trinket), the highest-win-rate core three-item builds, situational items, full build paths, skill max orders and level-by-level skill points, summoner spells, rune pages with stat shards, and final-item presence — each with games and win rate (0–1). Items, runes and spells are Data Dragon numeric ids. `patch` is the patch the numbers come from (TrackDIFF falls back one patch when the newest has too few games unless you pin `patch`). `null` means no build data for that champion/patch yet.

patch.description: Pin to a patch like "16.17"; omit for the latest with data.

rank_bucket.description: Rank scope, e.g. "DIAMOND_PLUS". Omit for all ranks.

name: get_champion_build
title: Champion build
